question: Does a planning rule learned by the agent improve its downstream decisions, and can a promoted rule produce a better successor?
registered_before: Any candidate is run or evaluated on this panel. The previously proposed three coefficients and historical calibration outcome are already known.

common_configuration.entry: unified_agent solve, protected self-review, anonymous task packets, no human action or evaluation labels supplied

initialization: G0 is three zeros. The first challenger is the exact historical v1 proposed from the table training trace and accepted on a next-task forecast proxy. Recompute and verify it. No historical proxy acceptance counts as downstream promotion.
mutation: The frozen ridge updater fits residual error of the current parent's score forecasts with equal total weight per historical task. Inputs are novelty, number of observed primary experiments, and intercept. Correction bounded to +/-0.10, coefficients +/-0.12. Affect feasible primary exploration utilities after the first measured primary result only. All arms have identical within-task self-review, recovery and delivery.
memory: Start with the six original training-side histories table/titles/n17/n29/n43/n61. For each later wave append just the pre-wave incumbent's training trace for each new case, irrespective of the winner. Never include outer predictions, outer scores, wave identifiers, model names or final cases as regression features. The historical first proposal used table only.
adaptation: Start step 0.6. After promotion multiply by 1.25 up to 1. After rejection halve down to 0.15. Only accepted policies are parents. Store each proposal, parent and evidence hashes before its wave. Do not alter the protocol in response to scores.

gate.score_route: equal-weight mean declared-metric gain >= 0.005, worst task >= -0.01, and an actual execution path changes
gate.efficiency_route: no individual score falls (tolerance 1e-12), at least 15 percent fewer total physical fits than the parent, and an actual execution path changes
gate.unit: a wave of two tasks, both arms completed, frozen and cross-process replayed before scoring either

waves.data: all UCI Wine rows from sklearn
800 noisy concentric circles, affine shifted into 8 dimensions with nuisance features, seed 655401
1000 synthetic categorical records with a conditional comparison and nuisance columns, seed 655402
800 stratified unique UCI SMS records excluding all normalized texts from the previous n29 training and evaluation feature packets
800 generated 12x12 noisy images of displaced stripes, crosses and diagonals, seed 655403
900 imbalanced synthetic numeric records, 32 features, five informative, nonlinear sign interaction, seed 655404

final_panel.data: 1000 distinct Fashion-MNIST public training images stratified within classes 0/2/4/6 (upper-body garments)
800 stratified distinct Cornell polarity v1.0 review snippets
1000 fresh Hastie 10-dimensional threshold examples from sklearn, seed 655405

final_controls: Before final prediction freeze G0, last accepted rule, immediate parent if distinct, and a one-shot update of G0 with exactly the same six historical plus six wave-incumbent traces, step 0.6. If no rule won, also measure the last rejected challenger as a diagnostic only. Byte-identical policies share a run on the same case. All predictions on all three final cases are frozen before any final labels are scored. Never select another rule with the final panel.
interpretation: Report per-task primary scores, actual trajectories, fits and changed prediction counts. Two successive actual promotions are needed to claim two improving generations on development. Transfer always reported independently; extra data vs recursion requires the final one-shot control. No released validation rerun, no course sealed tasks; all cases classify, and final panel is held out from this lineage, not necessarily new to the project.
